rule.description: Groups of at least 4 adjacent scalar parameters of the same C type are drilled through function signatures together (bugprone-easily-swappable-parameters with MinimumLength=4 and noise-suppression options disabled), instead of being carried by one aggregate budget/record type.

checks.description: Detect production functions whose signatures pass a cohesive memory/swap budget as a train of adjacent same-type scalar parameters instead of one bundle.
checks.detected_relation: function signature -> >=4 adjacent scalar parameters of the same type carrying one logical data group
checks.why_this_is_the_smell: The effective memory and swap budget of a cgroup (limits, usage, swap-account availability) and the swap-reporting values derived from it are one cohesive data group; passing them as bare same-type scalars through resolver, derived-value, and policy functions forces every caller and callee to repeat positional plumbing that a single record type would carry, and leaves the group incorrectly split across signatures.

matches.evidence: The exported budget resolver hands back the cgroup's RAM limit, RAM usage, memory+swap limit and memory+swap usage as four adjacent uint64_t* out-parameters (plus the swap-accounting flag), so callers receive one budget as a positional scalar train.

The swap report calculator consumes the same budget as four adjacent by-value uint64_t parameters (memlimit, memusage, memswlimit, memswusage) plus the swap-account flag and writes three more adjacent uint64_t results, mirroring the resolver's split instead of receiving the budget as one object.

The shared report-clamping policy threads the swap total, swap usage and swappiness hint as five adjacent by-value uint64_t scalars plus an out-pointer, so both /proc/swaps and /proc/meminfo must pass the derived swap numbers positionally.

excluded.description: Header declaration of cgroup_get_memswap_budget in src/cgroups/cgroup_utils.h
excluded.reason: The rule is evaluated on function definitions; the header prototype repeats the clump for readers of the API but is not a separate detection location.

excluded.description: Three-parameter limit readers such as get_memlimit and get_min_memlimit in src/cgroups/cgroup_utils.c
excluded.reason: Below the MinimumLength=4 threshold of the diagnostic rule for this case.

excluded.description: Pre-existing call-sites with three or fewer adjacent scalars (for example the host-snapshot readers in src/proc_fuse.c and the diskstats field readers)
excluded.reason: Groups smaller than four adjacent same-type parameters are not recognized as the data-clump relation credited by this case.
